title: Goldfish holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d="M 56 40 Q 60 50 58 60 Q 56 68 60 74" fill="none" stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="22" rx="12" ry="14" fill="#FF4466"/>
  <ellipse cx="51" cy="18" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#FF8899" opacity="0.7"/>
  <polygon points="52,36 56,36 54,40" fill="#CC2244"/>
  
  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <path d="M 18 62 Q 8 50 10 66 Q 6 74 18 72 Q 10 78 16 82 Q 22 74 24 68 Z" fill="#FF8800"/>
  
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="67" rx="26" ry="16" fill="#FFAA22"/>
  
  <!-- Body lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="72" rx="20" ry="9" fill="#FFD966"/>
  
  <!-- Dorsal fin -->
  <path d="M 35 53 Q 40 42 50 52 Q 45 54 42 56 Z" fill="#FF8800"/>
  
  <!-- Pectoral fin (back) -->
  <path d="M 38 70 Q 32 76 36 80 Q 40 76 42 72 Z" fill="#FF9900"/>
  
  <!-- Pectoral fin holding string (front) -->
  <path d="M 56 70 Q 62 66 64 60 Q 60 64 56 68 Z" fill="#FFB033"/>
  
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="62" cy="62" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="62" r="3" fill="#331100"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="61" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M 70 70 Q 72 68 70 66" fill="none" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx="66" cy="71" r="2.5" fill="#FF6688" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Scales suggestion -->
  <path d="M 38 62 Q 41 60 44 62" fill="none" stroke="#FFCC55" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 42 66 Q 45 64 48 66" fill="none" stroke="#FFCC55" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 34 66 Q 37 64 40 66" fill="none" stroke="#FFCC55" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
